mechanism: Tetrabenazine causes CNS depression and dopamine depletion which may be potentiated by vedolizumab's immunosuppressive effects on mood and neurological function, plus tetrabenazine's VMAT2 inhibition can unmask or worsen psychiatric symptoms in patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
action: Monitor for psychiatric adverse effects, depression, and suicidality when combining these agents; consider neuropsychiatric evaluation before initiating tetrabenazine in vedolizumab-treated patients.
